text_block_list.text:
Autumn... El Condor Pasa's comrades, 
Special Week and Grass Wonder, had 
achieved remarkable growth.

After hosting a special fan-service live 
with them, El Condor Pasa threw down the 
gauntlet to the two of them during the 
final talk show segment.

Special Week in the Japan Cup. Grass 
Wonder in the Arima Kinen... El Condor 
Pasa promised to face them in battle.

The three Umamusume voiced their 
determination together, ready to deliver 
top-tier entertainment to the audience.
